card.name: Quoted paths after grep in shell
card.fires_on: The opening quote and slash of a path argument after grep in Unix command examples, especially semanage fcontext output for web directories. It also fires on nearby command-line pieces.

modes.label: Quoted path after grep
modes.description: The quote and slash that begin a path pattern given to grep in an SELinux command line.

modes.label: Device lines in dmesg output
modes.description: The word at in kernel device lines after a dmesg grep command.
modes.example: dmesg | grep -i zipsd0<< at>> atapibus0 drive 1:

modes.label: Quote after equals or delimiter
modes.description: A quote mark joined to an attribute or option in code or command text.

card.plain: It marks the start of a file path or pattern typed after grep in Linux command examples.
